12,000 items across all 26 non-MT UFs (minimum >= 400 per UF) plus 8,000 national/cross-UF/comparative/unresolved cases, covering >1,200 distinct municipalities.

identified_gaps_and_round_09_remediation.description: Rounds 01-08 contained 0 three-filter combinations and 0 valid opened+closures cohort queries in the main frozen sets (leading to the Round 08 1,600-item adjudication).
identified_gaps_and_round_09_remediation.round_09_target: Include explicit 2-filter and 3-filter intersections (status + porte + contact, head_office + mei + contact, capital + natureza + head_office, opened + closures cohort, exclude_places + porte + status, etc.) verified by an independent filter-inventory pass.

identified_gaps_and_round_09_remediation.description: Rounds 01-08 had 0 cross-variable correlation or analytical feasibility items.
